mapper.update: MERGE INTO TCAR_PUSH_SUB T USING (SELECT #{endpoint} AS ENDPOINT FROM DUAL) S ON (T.ENDPOINT = S.ENDPOINT) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.KAKAO_ID = #{kakaoId}, T.P256DH = #{p256dh}, T.AUTH = #{auth}, T.USER_AGENT = #{userAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SUB_ID, KAKAO_ID, ENDPOINT, P256DH, AUTH, USER_AGENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (TCAR_PUSH_SUB_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{kakaoId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{userAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT S.SUB_ID, S.KAKAO_ID, S.ENDPOINT, S.P256DH, S.AUTH, S.USER_AGENT FROM TCAR_PUSH_SUB S JOIN TCAR_USER_KAKAO U ON U.KAKAO_ID = S.KAKAO_ID WHERE U.NOTIFY_LOGIN = 'Y'
AND S.KAKAO_ID != #{exceptKakaoId}
SELECT CFG_VALUE FROM TCAR_APP_CONFIG WHERE CFG_KEY = #{key}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TCAR_APP_CONFIG T USING (SELECT #{key} AS CFG_KEY FROM DUAL) S ON (T.CFG_KEY = S.CFG_KEY) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CFG_VALUE = #{value} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CFG_KEY, CFG_VALUE) VALUES (#{key}, #{value})
